newsitem.title: GREECE: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK EYES EXPANSION IN GREECE, BALKANS.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK EYES EXPANSION IN GREECE, BALKANS.

text.p: Macedonia Thrace Bank, a leading player in northern Greece, will seek to improve productivity, increase market share and expand in the Balkans, its president Spyros Kouniakis told an extraordinary shareholders meeting.
He said the bank's management will launch a more aggressive sales policy and expand its branch network seeking a denser presence in northern Greece -- its main market.

In this aim, 14 new branches will join the bank's network soon while the development of an ATM network is another priority. The goal is for ATMs to be operational in the first quarter of 1997, he said.
Macedonia Thrace wants to have a presence in Romania, Bulgaria and Yugoslavia seeking to capitalise on opportunities in the Balkan market.

Friday's shareholders meeting picked two new board members -- George Arvanitidis, mayor of Sindos and Alexander Vousvounis will replace outgoing John Ziagas and Demosthenis Giannoulopoulos, the bank said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
